title: Rebuild and verify my reference library: registry, relations, plates and palettes
why: The owner's references live only in the Git-ignored reference/ folder (atlas downloads and their own uploads). After adding or labelling references, or changing a family, layer or place they inform, rebuild the registry and prove it still works in the app. Unit tests run without the images; the browser check needs them locally and the dev server on 5173. It spends nothing.

steps.title: Rebuild reference/registry.json from the indexes and the committed labels
steps.why: Reports usable, unresolved and planned counts and any missing file.

steps.title: Label anything new before using it
steps.why: Look at each new image and add what it shows, its categories and what it informs to src/core/references/referenceLabels.ts. A logo or a wrong image informs nothing. A target that does not exist yet is planned:<id>, never a stand-in.

steps.title: Discovery, search, plate, palette, missing, tools, persistence, build exclusion
